title: Great tracker
body: Really solid tracking app overall. It tracks a ton of different things, and I personally use it for building better habits, improving my sleep, and general fitness. The data is super accurate and gives a great overview of your progress. The only minor downside is that you can’t go back to change an answer during the initial setup questionnaire if you miss click, but once you’re past that, the app itself works perfectly. Highly recommend!
author: Sawikiii

title: Routine creator
body: Now, when it's such a hard time to live through, people are missing an optimal routine, and this app could really help. People can feel that they are in good hands, that’s what the app said. At the beginning, there is a test, so the app will truly know how to help. I keep testing my 30-day program and I am very excited.

title: I can’t cancel my subscription
body:

Even when I want to send to the support team in the app I can’t type in a text as it doesn’t show what I am typing. 

Maybe some bugs to fix? 

Please do send me a reply. I used the same name in the app.
